name: RUFMARIASCH
description: Rufmariasch is an Austrian four-player Mariage variant. 32-card German pack (hearts, bells, acorns, leaves). Bidder calls a card (Ace or King) to choose partner. Aces, tens, last trick = 10 pts. King+Over (Queen) = mariage: 40 trumps, 20 other. Point-trick with called partner.

content.text: Rufmariasch is an Austrian four-player Mariage variant. 32-card German pack (hearts, bells, acorns, leaves). Bidder calls a card (Ace or King) to choose partner. Aces, tens, last trick = 10 pts. King+Over (Queen) = mariage: 40 trumps, 20 other. Point-trick with called partner.

Rufmariasch is a Danube Swabian variant of Mariáš for four players, played by the Donauschwaben (German settlers on the Danube) in 18th- and 19th-century Hungary. It belongs to the Mariage (king-queen) family of ace-ten games; the name combines the French mariage with German rufen (to call). It uses a 32-card William Tell pack and variable partnerships chosen by calling a card.

Dealer shuffles and the player to dealer's right cuts. The dealer deals four cards to each player and pauses. The player to dealer's left (forehand) calls a card by rank and suit; that suit becomes trumps and the holder is the caller's partner. The dealer then deals a second batch of four cards to each player so everyone has eight cards.
